function.description:
Retrieves the list of ThousandEyes test results along with related metrics. If `startTime` and `endTime` are not provided, the API defaults to the last 24 hours.

Please note that `siteId` filter (if used) should be using only site UUIDs of buildings.
  For detailed information about the usage of the API, please refer to the Open API specification document - https://github.com/cisco-en-programmability/catalyst-center-api-specs/blob/main/Assurance/CE_Cat_Center_Org-thousandEyesTestResults-1.0.0-resolved.yaml

Spec mapping: This tool follows ThousandEyes Test Results OpenAPI spec 1.0.0 for Catalyst Center 3.1.3 and 3.2.1. For an exact latest-result request, include the returned result id and test id in the final Markdown or KeyValueSet when those fields are available.
function.name: api_retrievesTheListOfThousandEyesTestResultsAlongWithR_c8c74987

X-CALLER-ID.description: Caller ID is used to trace the origin of API calls and their associated queries executed on the database. It's an optional header parameter that can be added to an API request.

agentId.description:
Unique identifier of the ThousandEyes agent.
Examples:

`agentId=199345` (filter for single agentId)

`agentId=1993458&agentId=499387` (filter for multiple agentIds)

Use only numeric ThousandEyes agent IDs here. If the user provides a hostname, FQDN, switch label, or agent display name, use networkDeviceName instead of agentId.

attribute.description: Attributes to return. Pass a JSON array for multi-field results. For latest/result summaries, request at most seven display fields by default, such as testName, testType, networkDeviceName, siteName, sampleTimestamp, latestPacketLoss, and totalActiveAlerts. Include id or testId only when the user asks for identifiers or when the result is needed for a follow-up path-trace lookup. For path-trace id resolution, request only attribute=["id"] with the same filters before calling api_readThousandEyesTestPathTraces.

endTime.description: End time to which API queries the data set related to the resource. It must be specified in UNIX epochtime in milliseconds. Value is inclusive.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to be fetched. If not provided, 500 records will be fetched by default Use values from 1 through 100 only. Default to 10 for current/latest summaries and use up to 100 for discovery or path-trace id lookup.

networkDeviceName.description:
Name of the network device as per the inventory. This supports `*` wildcard, and filtering is case-insensitve.

Use this for ThousandEyes agent hostnames, FQDNs, switch labels, and device names, including when the user calls the value an agent.

offset.description: The first record to show for this page. Minimum value is 1

order.description: The sort order of the field ascending or descending.

siteId.description:
The site UUID without the top level hierarchy. `siteId` must be a site UUID of a building. The list of buildings can be fetched using API `GET /dna/intent/api/v1/sites?type=building`.
Examples:

`siteId=buildingUuid` (single siteId requested)

`siteId=buildingUuid1&siteId=buildingUuid2` (multiple siteId requested)
 If the user provides a 36-character site UUID or explicitly says siteId, use that value directly. Do not call site lookup to resolve an already provided siteId.

sortBy.description: Attribute name by which the results should be sorted Supported sortBy values are testId, testName, testType, agentId, agentName, and networkDeviceName. Do not use sampleTimestamp as sortBy; request sampleTimestamp as an attribute and choose the latest row in the assistant response.

startTime.description: Start time from which API queries the data set related to the resource. It must be specified in UNIX epochtime in milliseconds. Value is inclusive.

testId.description:
Unique identifier of the ThousandEyes test.
Examples:

`testId=2043918` (filter for single testId)

`testId=2043918&testId=129440` (filter for multiple testIds)

testName.description:
Name of the ThousandEyes test. This supports `*` wildcard, and filtering is case-insensitve.

Examples:

`testName=Cisco Webex` (exact match)

`testName=Microsoft*` (starts with given string)

testType.description: Type of the ThousandEyes test. Please note that Catalyst Center supports only a subset of all possible ThousandEyes test types.
